description: This PHP source file defines the ViewFactory class used in SuiteCRM to load and instantiate different view components based on context, module, and configuration. It handles locating view files, applying customizations, and creating view objects.

classes.name: ViewFactory
classes.description: A factory class responsible for creating and configuring view objects used within SuiteCRM's MVC architecture.

methods.name: loadView
methods.description: Loads and returns a view object based on type, module, and other parameters, falling back to default views if specific files are not found.

methods.name: _loadConfig
methods.description: Loads configuration options for a specific view type, parsing various config files and merging their settings.

methods.name: _buildFromFile
methods.description: Creates a view object instance from a PHP file, trying different class naming conventions, including custom classes.

methods.name: _buildClass
methods.description: Instantiates and initializes a view class object, ensuring it is a SugarView or defaulting to SugarView.
